registered_by: Claude (LOCAL handoff 2026-11-21: market arms of #433 were not in the 2026-11-20 arms list)
evidence_rule: same as the extended profile (frozen before result only; venue x surface; min cell 12R; stages 30/100/300; no significance claim below 100R). Known-result replay of #433 (249R) never counts.
budget_note: These arms rebuild tickets with Production MEC, so their investment differs from Production. They are NOT the LOCAL C24 same-budget comparison; a same-budget variant needs its own registration before its first eligible card.
input_rule: market = signed JRA official market observation captured before prediction_cutoff (jra_role_candidate_replay.market_ranking); races without it are excluded and counted as excluded.

pfs_sensitivity.pfs_zero_max_payout: (total payout - largest single-race payout) / total investment (existing pfs_excl_max_payout)
pfs_sensitivity.pfs_drop_max_race: (total payout - that race payout) / (total investment - that race investment)
pfs_sensitivity.rule: the excluded race is the arm's own largest-payout race, fixed by this rule; both are reported, neither replaces the primary metric

arms.metric: net profit change vs frozen Production tickets; report investment change
arms.promote_if: at 300R net profit change > 0, PFS (both sensitivities) not lower than Production, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT -> Owner decision
arms.reject_if: at 100R net profit change < 0 and PFS excl. max payout lower

arms.metric: net profit change; must beat W_PLUS_STATIC_SAME_COUNT_CONTROL to credit the market signal (not width)
arms.promote_if: at 300R beats Production and W_PLUS_STATIC_SAME_COUNT_CONTROL on net profit and PFS excl. max payout, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT -> Owner decision
control arm; promotion only by a separate Owner decision
